verdictEs: Windrose.tools si quieres una única herramienta para 80% de los lookups de Windrose — mapa, talents, items, recipes en una sola pestaña. Calculators.games si necesitas matemática rigurosa: TTK contra bosses específicos, comparativa transparente de armor sets, validación numérica de builds antes de respec.
verdictEn: Windrose.tools if you want a single tool for 80% of Windrose lookups — map, talents, items, recipes in one tab. Calculators.games if you need rigorous math: TTK against specific bosses, transparent armor set comparison, numerical build validation before respec.

useCases.labelEs: Onboarding al juego: solo necesitas un sitio para arrancar
useCases.labelEn: Game onboarding: just need one site to get started
useCases.reasonEs: Cubre map, talents, items y discoveries en una UI integrada. Calculators.games asume que ya tienes contexto del juego — su UX no está pensada para beginners.
useCases.reasonEn: Covers map, talents, items, and discoveries in one integrated UI. Calculators.games assumes you already have game context — its UX isn't designed for beginners.

useCases.labelEs: Validar el TTK exacto de un build antes de comprometer respec
useCases.labelEn: Validate exact TTK of a build before committing to respec
useCases.reasonEs: Calculators.games muestra todos los modifiers aplicados (base damage, weapon scaling, talents, armor mitigation, set bonuses) y deja tweakear cada variable. Windrose.tools planea pero no calcula damage real.
useCases.reasonEn: Calculators.games shows every applied modifier (base damage, weapon scaling, talents, armor mitigation, set bonuses) and lets you tweak each variable. Windrose.tools plans but doesn't calculate real damage.

useCases.labelEs: Compartir un build con tu crew de co-op via link
useCases.labelEn: Share a build with your co-op crew via link
useCases.reasonEs: Windrose.tools exporta builds a URL compartible — paste el link y el receiver ve el build cargado. Calculators.games no tiene sharing fácil; requiere screenshots o transcripción manual del setup.
useCases.reasonEn: Windrose.tools exports builds to a shareable URL — paste the link and the recipient sees the loaded build. Calculators.games has no easy sharing; requires screenshots or manual setup transcription.

useCases.labelEs: Comparar dos armor sets contra el mismo boss
useCases.labelEn: Compare two armor sets against the same boss
useCases.reasonEs: Calculators.games permite abrir dos pestañas con builds distintos y contrastar TTK/DPS side-by-side. Windrose.tools no expone los numbers detrás del build para hacer esta comparación.
useCases.reasonEn: Calculators.games lets you open two tabs with different builds and contrast TTK/DPS side-by-side. Windrose.tools doesn't expose the numbers behind the build to make this comparison.

useCases.labelEs: Encontrar la ubicación de un recurso específico en tu mapa
useCases.labelEn: Find the location of a specific resource on your map
useCases.reasonEs: Windrose.tools tiene mapa seed-aware: subes tu save, ve dónde están las copper mines, faction camps y boss spawns reales de tu run. Calculators.games no tiene mapa.
useCases.reasonEn: Windrose.tools has a seed-aware map: upload your save, see where the copper mines, faction camps, and boss spawns actually are in your run. Calculators.games has no map.
